name: Money movement
use_case: A department that moves or posts money: disbursals, EMI collections, refunds, reconciliation (for example a lending company's Servicing).
floor: Reads the record for repeated asks, patterns (the same ask three or more times in seven days) and the four meters of every engine: Fit, Tick, Asks, Spend.
Proposes and never applies: a new engine, a change to an engine's steps, a rule change or a new department is always an ask the owner stamps.
Every proposal carries its evidence: the rows or meter readings that made it.
Proposes a new department when two meters run over on one engine, or when a piece of work has its own end date.
Proposes the department's function templates from its use case.
A change to an engine that moves money is proposed with a dry run on last week's records, never straight to live.
A reconciliation break seen twice is proposed as a standing check for Audit.
choices: Which pattern is worth an engine and which is noise.
Which step of an engine to change first.
Which week of records the dry run replays.
reads: Work items and how they ended.
The four meters of every engine.
Filed work and who used it.
Reconciliation breaks and how each was closed.
may_propose: A new engine written from a repeated ask.
A change to an engine's steps.
A rule change, filed to Identity.
A new department under the split rule.
A template for one of the five functions.
A standing check for Audit, from a repeated reconciliation break.
schedule: Weekly, whenever a pattern reaches three repeats in seven days, and after any reconciliation break.
checks: Every pattern seen this cycle is either proposed or recorded as not worth an engine, with the reason.
Every proposal filed this cycle carries its evidence rows.
No change was applied without a stamp.
Every proposed change to a money engine this cycle carries a dry run.
